inventoryCommon.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds one on Companies.

itemStock.emptyBody: Stock appears after opening stock (Warehouse), a goods receipt or a transfer in.
itemStock.foot: Available = released stock minus what is reserved for transfers. QC hold and in-transit stock are never available.
itemStock.noLots: No lots with stock. Items without lot numbers are counted in one figure.

stock.insufficient: There is not enough released stock for this. Stock never goes below zero.
stock.reserved: That stock is reserved for a transfer, so it cannot be used for anything else.
stock.qty: Every quantity must be above zero.
stock.bucket: Returns go back to stores or into QC hold.
stock.place_missing: Choose the store to take the stock from.
stock.place_other_company: Choose a place of this company.
stock.lot_mismatch: That lot is not of this item and company.
stock.lot_not_released: That lot is not released yet. Only tested, released lots can be used.
stock.target: Say what the stock is issued for.
stock.return_exceeds: You can return at most what is still out on that issue.

count.state: The count is not in a state that allows this.
count.qty: Enter the counted quantity (zero or more).
count.line_missing: That line is not on this count.
count.incomplete: Count every line before sending it for approval.

qc.not_in_quarantine: This lot is not waiting in QC hold.
qc.result: The result is pass, fail or hold.
qc.no_pass: The latest test must be a pass before the lot is released.
qc.no_fail: Record the failed test before rejecting the lot.

scrap.not_scrap_item: Choose a scrap or regrind item (marked as scrap in the product master).
scrap.no_invoice: Choose the posted GST invoice for this scrap sale.
scrap.already_out: Stock for this invoice has already been taken out.
scrap.no_scrap_lines: That invoice has no scrap items.

transfer.state: The transfer is not at the step for this action.
transfer.places: Choose two active places of this company.
transfer.same_place: The two places must be different.
transfer.no_gstin: Both branches need their GSTIN set on Branches first.
transfer.wrong_lot: Pick the lot that was asked for.
transfer.line_missing: That line is not on this transfer.
transfer.invoice_required: This move is to another GSTIN: post the tax invoice to that GSTIN first and link it.
transfer.invoice_invalid: Link a posted tax invoice from the sending GSTIN.
transfer.invoice_used: That invoice is already linked to another transfer.
transfer.invoice_wrong_party: The invoice must be billed to the receiving GSTIN.
transfer.invoice_needs_igst: A move to another state is billed with IGST.
transfer.invoice_short: The invoice does not cover every item being sent.
transfer.role: The handover is confirmed by the picker, then the carrier.
transfer.extra_goods: More than was sent is not added here. The sending place checks and makes an extra dispatch.
transfer.return_exceeds: Return at most what is still in transit.
transfer.write_off_exceeds: Write off at most what is still in transit.
transfer.unbalanced: Every unit must be accounted for before closing: find, return or write off what is still in transit.

sod.own_request: You made this request, so you cannot approve it. Another person must approve it.
sod.own_count: You counted or submitted this count, so you cannot post it. Someone who did not count must approve the differences.
sod.tester_receiver: You received these goods, so you cannot test them. Another person must test the lot.
sod.releaser_receiver: You received these goods, so you cannot release or reject them.
sod.not_picker: Only the person who picked confirms the handover.
sod.picker_carrier: The carrier confirms on their own login, not the picker.
sod.picker_receiver: You picked this transfer, so you cannot receive it.
sod.witness_required: You carried these goods: a second authorised person must witness the receipt.
sod.write_off: A shortage is never written off by the picker, the carrier or the receiver.
sod.picker_close: The picker or the carrier cannot close the transfer. Someone else must close it.
